aboutHeading: 15 Years of Landscaping Excellence in Newport
aboutText: With more than a decade and a half of experience, PJR Landscaping & Design has been the go-to choice for homeowners in Newport VIC. We offer comprehensive landscaping services, from initial design concepts to full installation and maintenance. Our passion lies in crafting unique gardens that enhance your property's value and enjoyment.
servicesText: At PJR Landscaping, we provide a wide range of services including garden design, lawn installation, and hardscaping. Our team works closely with you to ensure every project meets your vision and budget. Serving Newport and nearby areas with professional excellence.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: We create bespoke garden designs that suit your space and style, ensuring a harmonious outdoor environment.

services.title: Lawn Installation & Care
services.desc: Expert installation of new lawns and ongoing maintenance to keep your grass lush and healthy.

services.title: Paving & Hardscaping

services.title: Planting & Garden Bed Construction
services.desc: Strategic planting and raised bed construction to add colour and texture to your garden.

services.title: Irrigation & Water Features
services.desc: Efficient irrigation systems and beautiful water features to enhance garden sustainability and aesthetics.

services.title: Outdoor Structures & Lighting
services.desc: Construction of pergolas, decks, and landscape lighting for functional and inviting outdoor areas.
